prompt.v: The heights of adult women are normally distributed, with a mean of 165 cm and a standard deviation of 6 cm. Out of 1,000, about how many are between 153 cm and 159 cm?

problems.text: normal count: 1000 values, mean 165 sd 6, from 153 to 159
problems.explain: 153 cm is 2 SD below and 159 cm is 1 SD below. Each band of one SD on one side holds 34%, 13.5%, 2.35% and 0.15% going out from the mean, so this is 13.5%. 13.5% of 1,000 is 0.135 × 1,000 = 135.
